title: H company releases Holo4 agentic model series
excerpt: The new models are available in 27B dense and 35B-A3B Mixture of Experts configurations on the H Models API.
bodyHtml:
H company announced the release of Holo4, a new series of agentic models designed to interact with software through GUIs, code, MCP, and APIs. The models are available in two sizes: 27B dense and 35B-A3B Mixture of Experts. These models are capable of clicking and typing on a screen, writing and running code, and calling MCP or API tools depending on the requirements of the task.

According to H company, the models were trained through supervised and reinforcement learning using environments and tasks generated by their Agentic Task Factory. The company also released Holotron4 Nano, an updated version of its previous Holotron 3 model. The company states that Holo4 models improve significantly over their Qwen base and compete with frontier models on academic benchmarks for desktop control and API use at a lower cost per task.

Holo4 models are available on the H Models API, with weights provided on Hugging Face in BF16, FP8, NVFP4, and 4-bit GGUF formats. The company also stated that it will release optimized DSpark drafter checkpoints in the coming days to further accelerate inference.
